text: What is the primary objective of a Departmental Undertaking in the public sector?
options: To earn profits
To provide essential services
To create employment opportunities
To promote private enterprises
correctAnswer: To provide essential services
explanation: According to the NCERT textbook, Departmental Undertakings are established to provide essential services such as railways, post and telegraph, etc. These undertakings are managed by government departments and are financed by the government.

text: Which of the following is a characteristic of a Statutory Corporation?
options: It is a company registered under the Companies Act
It is a departmental undertaking
It is established by a special Act of Parliament
It is a joint venture between public and private sectors
correctAnswer: It is established by a special Act of Parliament
explanation: As per the NCERT textbook, a Statutory Corporation is established by a special Act of Parliament, which defines its powers, functions, and responsibilities. This characteristic distinguishes it from other forms of public sector enterprises.

text: What is the main advantage of a Government Company?

It is financed by the government
It has autonomy in decision-making
It is not subject to government control
correctAnswer: It has autonomy in decision-making

text: Which of the following is a feature of a Multinational Corporation (MNC)?
options: It operates only in the domestic market
It is owned and controlled by the government
It has operations in several countries
It is a small-scale enterprise
correctAnswer: It has operations in several countries
explanation: As per the NCERT textbook, an MNC is a large business enterprise that has operations in several countries. This feature distinguishes MNCs from other types of businesses, which may operate only in the domestic market or have limited international presence.

text: What is the primary objective of a Joint Venture?
options: To reduce competition
To increase profits
To share risks and resources
To acquire new technology
correctAnswer: To share risks and resources
explanation: According to the NCERT textbook, a Joint Venture is a business arrangement in which two or more companies share risks and resources to achieve a common objective. This objective is to pool their resources, expertise, and risk-taking capacity to achieve a specific goal.

text: Which of the following is a benefit of Public-Private Partnership (PPP)?
options: It increases the financial burden on the government
It reduces the role of the private sector
It improves the quality of public services
It decreases the efficiency of service delivery
correctAnswer: It improves the quality of public services
explanation: As per the NCERT textbook, PPP is a partnership between the public and private sectors to deliver high-quality public services. This partnership allows the private sector to bring in its expertise, technology, and management skills to improve the quality of public services.

To deliver public services
To provide infrastructure support and regulation
